findings.title: Validated default birth is discarded before delegation
findings.trigger: Omit started_epoch; later time.time reading rolls backward or becomes nonfinite after wrapper validation.
findings.actual: Wrapper validates default birth at its first clock read, then forwards unchanged request. Legacy apply reads the clock again and stores its later value as started_epoch.
findings.expected: The stored helper birth must be the validated finite prospective birth, at or after installed receipt effective_epoch.
findings.narrow_repair: Carry the validated birth into a copied forwarded helper-start request. Preserve original request, frozen APIs, all other actions, original campaign clock/deadline, history, budgets and accounting.

verified_scope: All exact input pins match before and after review.
All 15 author tests pass under unchanged source bytes and owned dependency-copy read mapping.

15 further independent tests pass: strict one-time installation, receipts/types, pins/symlink/source drift, prospective explicit births, auth isolation and deep copy, original clock/history preservation, helper-end old semantics, event/close/status delegation.
Old six-helper API remains isolated; successor accepts twelve and rejects thirteenth.
Native admission delegates unchanged; helper cap exists only at helper-start. No native controller change is required.
scoped_limitations: No live transaction/save/apply, installation, native/provider/unit/profile/auth actions, candidate/source answers, canon or Git changes.
Clock-edge cases are controlled adversarial mocks, not an observation of a current live clock fault.
Original helper-end keeps its old proof-storage semantics; root must verify positive frozen source/manifest evidence before ending a helper.
Full source files were executed unchanged with campaign file reads mapped to owned exact copies. Mock helper/admission actions mutate copied in-memory states only.
The first isolation harness attempt blocked two author temporary writes outside the owned LAB. Harness tempfile placement was corrected; original failing output is retained.
No separate source FREEZE file existed; source MANIFEST.json supplies the pinned original source freeze.
